$description: Toza v2 design tokens, Direction A (private bank). W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. Single source of colours, type, spacing and radii (V-037). styles/tokens.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs; never edit it by hand. Alpha colours are CSS colour strings (rgb() with slash alpha) so the generated CSS is exact.

com.toza.css.note: CSS variable name = '--' + path joined with '-' (a leaf named DEFAULT drops its suffix). A group with 'prefix' replaces its own path with that prefix. A token with 'emit: false' is documentation only. Composite typography tokens emit one variable per member: --type-<name>-<member>.

sans.$description: UI and body text. Self-hosted Assistant (latin + hebrew subsets).

body.$description: Same stack as font.sans; Flowbite reads --font-body.

serif.$description: Headings, numerals, stage labels. Self-hosted Frank Ruhl Libre (latin + hebrew subsets).

paper-deep.$description: Recessed ivory. Alternating sections, start card, bars.

ink.$description: Deep ink green. Headings, primary action, inverse sections.

ink-soft.$description: Ink, one step lighter. Primary action hover.

text.$description: Body text. Also the semantic text colour.

doc-paper.$description: Specimen document paper, lighter than the page.

shadow-ambient.$description: Specimen document: soft ambient shadow (ink at 35%).

on-dark-border-strong.$description: Ghost button border on ink (paper at 55%).

action-inverse-hover.$description: Primary action on ink: hover background.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed surface for alternating bands and callouts.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text on surface. 6.3:1 on paper.

accent.$description: Accent on light surfaces. 5.2:1 on paper, text-safe.

accent-on-dark.$description: Accent on inverse surfaces. 7:1 on ink.

action-inverse.$description: Primary action on inverse surfaces: background.

on-action-inverse.$description: Primary action on inverse surfaces: text.

flowbite.$description: Flowbite semantic variables remapped onto the Toza palette. Names are fixed by Flowbite; do not rename. body is the primary text colour, body-subtle the secondary one; neutral-primary* is the page paper, neutral-secondary*/tertiary* the recessed paper, dark* the ink, default*/neutral-quaternary the hairline.

display.$description: h1 / .display. Size is set per page (home hero: 2.625rem, 3.75rem from sm, 5rem from lg).

h2.$description: Section heading (.h2). Fluid size: CSS clamp(), not expressible as a DTCG dimension.

text.$description: Tailwind font-size scale entries (text-<name>) for the Direction A display sizes.

h2.$description: Section heading, fluid (text-h2); same value as type.h2 font size.

numeral.$description: Prices line height (leading-numeral). Tailwind's leading-none is overridden by Flowbite's theme, so prices name their own.

wrap.$description: Content width as a Tailwind container size (max-w-wrap).

spacing.$description: Named Tailwind spacing steps for the page layout (px-gutter, py-section, ...), aliases of the layout tokens.

float-gap.$description: Gap between the floating contact buttons (gap-float-gap).

float-edge.$description: Distance of the floating contact group from the viewport side (px-float-edge).

float.$description: Floating contact buttons (WhatsApp, Signal): one stacked group, fixed to a physical viewport corner on every page, LTR and RTL.

side.$description: Physical side of the viewport the group sits on: right or left. The one deliberate exception to logical properties: the owner wants the buttons in the same screen corner in LTR and RTL. Change this one value to move them.

size.$description: Button diameter (52px, above the 44px target minimum).

edge.$description: Distance from the viewport side; equals the page gutter.

offset.$description: Distance above the bottom edge, added to the iOS safe-area inset.

z.$description: Stacking order: above page content, below the sticky header (z-40).

fade.$description: Fade in and out. Not applied under prefers-reduced-motion.

float.$description: Floating contact buttons: soft ink shadow (shadow-float).

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind defaults, documented here because the CSS media queries use them. Not emitted: redefining --breakpoint-* would change every responsive utility.

md.$description: Stage columns, price strip brackets, price facts as ruled rows.

lg.$description: Full desktop layout, section padding 7rem, sticky navs.
